item.title: Half-brothers sentenced to hundreds of years in prison in connection with crime spree, homicide
item.description: A Jefferson Parish judge sentenced a pair of half-brothers to hundreds of years in prison in connection with a 2017 crime spree on Wednesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: Journalist, Honorary Muse Soledad O'Brien arrives in New Orleans for Mardi Gras
item.description: Award-winning journalist Soledad O'Brien is in New Orleans to be this year's Honorary Muse in the Krewe of Muses parade.

item.title: Orleans Parish District Attorney's Office sees high conviction rates at start of year
item.description: It's been a strong, successful start to 2026 in prosecuting suspected murderers, according to the Orleans Parish District Attorney's Office.

item.title: Entergy New Orleans reminds people mylar balloons, confetti cannons prohibited on parade routes
item.description: Parades are now rolling every day through Fat Tuesday. As the krewes get ready to toss some of their signature throws, Entergy New Orleans is reminding people that certain items are not allowed along the parade route.

item.title: Gregory Aymond's resignation accepted, James Checchio to be seated as Archbishop of New Orleans
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has officially accepted the resignation of Archbishop of New Orleans, Most Reverend Gregory M. Aymond.

item.title: Folsom man accused of child sexual exploitation
item.description: A Folsom man was arrested Tuesday, Feb. 10 in connection with a child sexual exploitation investigation.

item.title: Jefferson Parish placing time capsule to be opened in 2125
item.description: Jefferson Parish will commemorate the end of its bicentennial with a time capsule ceremony on Wednesday, Feb. 11.

item.title: Smooth Streets initiative would invest $6 million in New Orleans road repairs
item.description: Mayor Helena Moreno is expediting infrastructure projects in New Orleans. At a press conference Wednesday she announced she will invest city funds into paving and roadwork equipment as well as new city employees to operate it.

item.title: Main rain chance through Carnival is early Sunday
item.description: NEW ORLEANS (WGNO) — It’s a quiet and warm stretch of weather to finish out the workweek. High pressure remains in control, keeping conditions dry and temperatures running above normal. item.description: Various Saints players will ride in the Krewe of Tucks Saturday, Feb. 14.
